_note: Curated no-coordinate Nuka-Cola sources (Collectrons, Resource Generators, dedicated/instanced Vendors). ATX/CAMP/event items have no Mappalachia world coordinates, so they are listed here by hand — same pattern as data/vendors/vendor_overrides.tsv. Add a variant key + entries when a new skin ships. Detection of the placed sources stays fully automatic in classify(); only these coordless items need curation.

collectrons.name: Nuka-Cola Collectron Station
collectrons.note: CAMP collectron pod that periodically deposits Nuka-Cola into its stash.

resource_generators.name: Nuka-Cola Mystery Machine
resource_generators.note: CAMP vending machine that dispenses a random classic Nuka-Cola flavour on a timer. Skins: Pristine, Americana.

vendors.name: Nuka-World on Tour — Nuka-Cola Vendor
vendors.note: Dedicated vendor that always stocks Nuka-Cola during the Nuka-World on Tour event (instanced — no fixed map coordinates).

collectrons.name: Nuka-Cola Quantum Collectron Station
collectrons.note: CAMP collectron pod that periodically deposits Nuka-Cola Quantum into its stash.
